dedupe_keys.name: future indian electricity demand scenarios to 2050

description: This MIT deposit supplies projected electricity demand for India through 2050 at state, regional and national scales. The associated own code documentation describes a business-as-usual regression component and a technology component that generates hourly profiles at different spatial resolutions. Zenodo record 4564581 publishes a single data archive under CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. The own landing page does not enumerate every scenario combination or the internal archive format, so users must inspect the package before selecting a consistent series. These projections can provide demand inputs for generation and transmission capacity simulations, offering an Indian scenario resource alongside historical balance collections such as data-eurostat-energy-statistics. A caveat is that outputs depend on GDP projections and technology assumptions, not representing forecasts with demonstrated predictive accuracy. The provider specifically warns that GDP assumptions must remain consistent between the regression and technology components. The archive was not downloaded, and demand totals or scenario differences were not calculated.
